lines.en: Thais, did you hear? The school secretary asked whether the exam had been postponed until next week.
lines.pt: Thais, você ouviu? A secretária da escola perguntou se a prova tinha sido adiada para a semana que vem.

lines.en: I heard something different. Mrs Lopez told me that the schedule had been changed because of the storm.
lines.pt: Ouvi algo diferente. A Sra. Lopez me disse que o horário tinha sido mudado por causa da tempestade.

lines.en: Then I wonder if the notice had been sent to all the students, or only to the seniors.
lines.pt: Então me pergunto se o aviso tinha sido enviado a todos os alunos ou só aos formandos.

lines.en: I asked the office whether the message had been delivered. They said it had been emailed last night.
lines.pt: Perguntei à secretaria se a mensagem tinha sido entregue. Disseram que foi enviada por e-mail ontem à noite.

lines.en: Funny, I never received it. My cousin asked me whether I had been checking my junk folder.
lines.pt: Engraçado, nunca recebi. Meu primo me perguntou se eu tinha verificado minha pasta de lixo eletrônico.

lines.en: Good point. He told me to look there first, and I found it among the old newsletters.
lines.pt: Boa observação. Ele me disse para olhar lá primeiro, e eu achei entre os boletins antigos.

lines.en: Great. What does it say? Did they explain why the room had been moved to the second floor?
lines.pt: Ótimo. O que diz? Eles explicaram por que a sala tinha sido mudada para o segundo andar?

lines.en: Yes. They said the library had been flooded, so the whole exam had been transferred to Room 12.
lines.pt: Sim. Disseram que a biblioteca tinha sido alagada, então a prova inteira foi transferida para a sala 12.

lines.en: That makes sense. I asked the teacher if we could bring dictionaries, but she said it was forbidden.
lines.pt: Faz sentido. Perguntei ao professor se podíamos levar dicionários, mas ele disse que era proibido.

lines.en: Of course. She also reminded us that all phones must be left in the lockers before the test.
lines.pt: Claro. Ela também nos lembrou que todos os celulares devem ficar nos armários antes da prova.

lines.en: Fine. Let’s go and ask whether the lockers have been unlocked, or we will be late.
lines.pt: Certo. Vamos perguntar se os armários foram destrancados, ou vamos nos atrasar.

facts.label: Perguntas reportadas
facts.sub: She asked whether the exam had been postponed. He told me the room had been moved.

facts.label: asked whether/if
facts.sub: Para relatar perguntas de sim/não, use asked whether ou asked if + sujeito + verbo: She asked whether the exam had been postponed. Sem inversão e sem do/does.

facts.label: had been + particípio
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, o presente perfeito passivo vira past perfect passivo: has been moved vira had been moved. Is cancelled vira was cancelled.

items.s: She asked whether the exam had been postponed is correct.
We say “She asked had the exam been postponed”.
items.why: We say She asked whether the exam had been postponed.

items.s: Had been + participle is a past perfect passive.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She asked whether the exam had been postponed is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She asked had the exam been postponed”. → Falso (We say She asked whether the exam had been postponed.)
Had been + participle is a past perfect passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Confusing notices · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a stormy morning in Austin. Dale walks into the school hall. A notice board is full of papers. Students talk in worried voices. Nobody knows where the exam will be. Ana arrives with a wet umbrella.

“Ana, did you hear? The school secretary asked whether the exam had been postponed until next week.” says Dale. “I heard something different. Mrs Lopez told me that the schedule had been changed because of the storm.” says Ana. “Then I wonder if the notice had been sent to all the students, or only to the seniors.” says Dale.
